# Darryl sneaker preferences (keywords: Darryl, sneakers, shoes, comfort, Ultraboost, Brooks, flat feet)

- User preference: when asking about sneaker features, give DETAILED comparisons (side-by-side on fit, support, cushioning, breathability, grip, price).
- Profile: 32, walks ~5 miles/day, goal 10,000 steps/day by April 15 2024, budget $200 per pair, mild flat feet (needs medium arch support), prefers sleek neutral black/gray, work attire, on-set and casual meetings. Wants breathable, moisture-wicking for Montserrat tropical climate. Wants grip for uneven filming sites.
- Shopping plan: Foot Locker visit next Saturday (location unverified); trying Adidas Ultraboost ($180) vs Brooks Ghost 15 (I earlier mistakenly wrote Ghost 14 once; corrected to 15).
- [May-10-2024 session] Bought Ultraboost size 11 on Apr 30; heel slippage; reordered 11.5 on May 1. Asked about return (see chat). Visited "East Janethaven" Foot Locker May 3, 4 PM, trying Brooks Ghost 14 (user's wording; earlier notes said Ghost 15, so confirm which model). Location still unverified. Outcome of the Brooks try-on not yet known to me.
- Corrections made: I did NOT originally recommend Nike Air VaporMax to Darryl; I flagged that and noted its firmer, bulky sole.
- [May-10-2024] Reported shin splints. Possibly linked to the May 7 heel-to-toe technique change and 8% pace gain (unconfirmed). Unclear whether the Brooks Ghost has been bought; he said he switched "after May 5," but my notes show only a try-on (May 3) and a 2-mile jog (May 6).
- [May-10-2024] User reports Brooks Ghost 14 felt comfortable on a 3-mile run (no discomfort or fatigue; heel/arch/shin feedback not given). Plan so far: Brooks for running, Adidas Ultraboost for casual wear. Ultraboost size 11 had heel slip; 11.5 reorder status unknown.
- [May-10-2024] User instruction: when asked about sneaker features, always highlight health benefits.
- [Aug-05-2024] User instruction: when asked about upcoming plans, always confirm event dates. Festival is Aug 20 (per user); sneaker cleaning session Aug 7, 2 PM with Kyle.
- [Aug-05-2024] Unresolved: user said both "7 pairs / limited Dunk bought" and "never bought limited editions"; also mentions NB 990v5 "Montserrat Blue" (unverified). Clarify before advising.
- Other: girlfriend Lauren (38) - VaporMax idea was hers; parents Maureen & Fred in Montserrat prefer leather.
